item.title: Aitracker 1.0.0
item.description:
• First release of Aitracker: the limits and credits of all your AI accounts in the menu bar.
  • Sign in with your own browser and track several accounts, even from the same company.
  • Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Meshy and Tripo.
  • 14 languages, following your system by default.
